title: Grey words under the text box; Submit a ticket's buttons on the bottom line

steps.path: Rename session · Pick a handle · Settings → Assistant → Cloud → Connect OpenRouter · Projects → Turn on sync
steps.headline: All four now read the same way: box name, text box, then grey words under it.
steps.changed: Pick a handle's explanation, OpenRouter's three steps and Turn on sync's two paragraphs moved from above the text box to under it, as Rename's line already was. All the words under a text box are now the same lighter grey.
steps.notice: OpenRouter's step 3 now says "Paste the key above", since the box is now above the steps.
steps.risk: On OpenRouter you now see the empty box before the steps that explain where the key comes from.

steps.path: Settings → Development → Submit a ticket (writing it, and reviewing before sending)
steps.headline: Submit a ticket's buttons now sit on the popup's pinned bottom line, your pick.
steps.changed: Review ticket, Back to draft / Submit, and the Done / Open buttons moved onto the pinned bottom line, like Close session and Update.
steps.notice: The pictures look the same before and after: this popup is short enough here that nothing scrolls. On a smaller window, or once the logs are opened, the boxes now scroll while the buttons stay visible at the bottom. Before, the buttons scrolled away with the boxes.
steps.risk: No wording changed. If sending fails, the error notice with Try again also stays on the bottom line, where the buttons were.
